title: Action document
description: The document that a service publishes at /.well-known/procurauth/actions (protocol 5.1, 5.2). It declares the types, the actions and the limits of the service. A schema cannot check the rules between members. For example, a type name occurs one time, a parent exists, and the depth is 4 at most. The tool access-lint checks them.

server.description: The id of the service. It is equal to the claim aud of the identity tokens of the service.

resource_types.description: The tree of types below the service. The type service is the root, and the document does not declare it.

actions.description: The actions of the service. The list never has the action access.

resources.description: The nodes that the service names. Each path starts below the service.

limits.description: The limit declarations of the service (protocol 6.1).

id.description: An exact string of 1 to 256 characters, with no control character (protocol 4.1). The Rust reader counts bytes, and a schema counts characters.

type_name.description: A type name or a limit name: 1 to 32 characters, a to z first, then a to z, 0 to 9 or underscore.

name.description: The name of the type. It is not service.

parent.description: The parent: service, or a type that the document declares.

name.description: The name of the action: 1 to 64 characters, parts of a to z, 0 to 9 and underscore, with a dot between the parts. It is not access.

resource_types.description: The types on which a grant of the action is valid: service or declared types, each one time.

limits.description: The names of the limits of the action (protocol 6.2). Each name is declared in the member limits of the document.

resource.description: One node that the service names (protocol 5.2).

path.description: Segments of the form type:id, with a slash between them. The path does not hold the service. Each id is percent-encoded: each byte outside A-Z, a-z, 0-9, hyphen, dot, underscore and tilde becomes a percent sign and two upper-case hexadecimal digits. The path has 4 segments at most.

actions.description: The actions of the node. Each name is declared in the member actions of the document.

limit_declaration.description: One limit declaration (protocol 6.1). An unknown member makes the document bad (protocol 5.3).

min.description: The lowest value of a ceiling. A whole number of 0 or more. It is not above max.

max.description: The highest value of a ceiling. A whole number of 0 or more.

then.description: A budget has neither min nor max. A budget name never starts with max_ (protocol 6.1, 7.1).

limits.name: max_rows
limits.label: Most rows
limits.description: The most rows that one read gives.

limits.name: max_duration
limits.label: Longest run
limits.description: The longest run of one use, in seconds.
